validity.researcher_notes: EXISTENCE: solidly real, NOT a hallucination and NOT GEM-only. This row is Package 12 of Aramco's Master Gas System expansion Phase 3 (MGS-3), awarded to Gas Arabian Services Company. Two INDEPENDENT origins agree: (1) MEED (editorial trade press, Feb 2024) describes Package 12 verbatim as 'Laying 16-inch, 12-inch and 4-inch lateral pipelines in the Eastern Province and Qassim region clusters, covering 116km', won by Gas Arabian; (2) Zawya/Tadawul (May 2024) reports Gas Arabian's own Saudi Exchange filing that it won the 'Master Gas System expansion in East and Qassim Clusters' EPC contract, value SAR 416,255,967 (=$111m), 30-month duration. A third independent project-intelligence compilation (BlackRidge Research) also carries the 116km Eastern/Qassim scope. HIGH confidence. CLASSIFICATION: Fuel=Gas and PipelineType=transmission are supported - this is part of the Master Gas System (Aramco's national gas transmission network). Minor caveat: the pipe here is small-diameter LATERAL pipe (4/12/16-inch laterals off the 56-inch MGS trunk lines), i.e. lateral/feeder scale rather than main transmission, but it is correctly counted as part of the transmission expansion and 'transmission' is defensible. DUPLICATE: NOT a duplicate. The diameter signature 12,4,16-in + 116 km uniquely maps to MGS-3 Package 12 and is distinct from every other roster row - notably P6733 (470 km, 12/16/10/4-in) and all the 56-inch trunk segments (P6717-P6731). Gas Arabian's OTHER MGS-3 award, Package 3 ('Shedgum to EWPS-1', 56 km / 56-in, $92m/SAR 344,614,412, 40 months), is a SEPARATE physical pipe and would be a different roster row - do not conflate it with P6732. ATTRIBUTION: Owner=Aramco 100% correct (MGS is wholly Aramco's system). Endpoints Eastern Province -> Qassim confirmed by MEED and BlackRidge. SPEC: Length 116 km (MEED, BlackRidge), Diameter 12/4/16-in (MEED), SegmentCost $111m / SAR 416,255,967 (Zawya Tadawul filing) all independently confirmed. StartYear1=2027 is plausible but soft: the Package-12 contract is 30 months from the ~May 2024 award => completion ~late 2026, though the overall MGS-3 program is scheduled to complete Q4 2028; 2027 sits reasonably between the segment schedule and program end. Capacity is blank and should STAY blank - the only capacity figure available (3.2 bcf/d added, 15.7 bcf/d system total) is system-wide MGS-3, not a per-segment number, so filling it would be fabrication. NOTE: the row's aramco.com ref (aramcos-strategic-gas-expansion-progresses-with-25bn-contract-awards) timed out in url_verifier (ReadTimeout / bot-block) and could not be re-verified this pass; it is a program-level release that does not name Package 12 anyway. Verified independent refs are staged instead.

status_reviews.researcher_notes: 'construction' is confirmed and the row is NOT stale. The Package-12 EPC contract was formally awarded to Gas Arabian in May 2024 (Zawya/Tadawul filing) with a 30-month schedule, and MGS-3 construction commenced Q2 2024 (MEED, BlackRidge). The MGS-3 program is demonstrably active through 2025 (independent 2025 evidence: L&T completed a 120 km / 56-in Package-8 stretch reported Apr 2025; YSG completed Package-8 site buildings Apr 2025) - though note that 2025 progress evidence is PROGRAM/sibling-package level (Package 8), not Package-12-specific. Package-12-specific dated evidence remains the May 2024 award + Q2 2024 construction start, i.e. ~2 years into a 30-month build as of mid-2026 - well within an active-construction window (far under the 2y dormancy threshold). No completion/commissioning news found for this segment, so no upgrade to operating. StartYear1=2027 is consistent (30 months from mid-2024 -> late 2026/2027; overall MGS-3 completion Q4 2028). Searched EN trade press (MEED, Zawya, Construction Week, Pipeline Journal), project-intelligence (BlackRidge, DMS Projects) and Aramco releases. evidence_date 2025-04 reflects newest independent MGS-3 activity; segment-specific = 2024-05.
